_about: CAMP [the heal button, damage that stays], rule 226 (Paolo 10/26: 'in Battle Brothers you can't just do fights back to back, your people need to heal... healing is important, the damage you sustained in battle'). The company's condition between fights: how fast the hitpoints a man lost come back with the map's clock, how fast his armour is mended with TAPE (rule 209: tape is the repair tools), and what making camp and the retinue change. Every number is Battle Brothers' own, read from the wiki copy in the repo (reference/library/grok/wiki/PAGES_ALL.tar.gz), the hard end of rule 117's slider (rule 226 is newer and names Battle Brothers' rates). engine/bohemia_condition.js reads this file; it carries the same numbers as its own defaults so the game works before the file lands. TUNING's one table reads the rows from here (NOTE on TUNING's board). MECHANISM-MINE / CONTENTS-PAOLO'S: the rates are a ruling (226), the felt number is TUNING's to move.

hp_per_hour_march.unit: hitpoints a man gets back an hour on the map
hp_per_hour_march.source: bb_all/0160_Attributes.txt: 'On the world map lost hitpoints are recovered at a rate of 1HP/hour on march and 2HP/hour while camping or escorting a caravan.'

hp_per_hour_camp.unit: hitpoints a man gets back an hour while the company is camped

cook_hp_per_hour.unit: hitpoints more an hour with THE COOK in the retinue
cook_hp_per_hour.source: bb_all/1952_The Cook (Follower).txt: 'Increases hitpoint healing rate by 1 per hour' (the Attributes page says 33 percent; the follower's own page wins)

armour_per_hour.unit: points of durability each worn piece (body armour, helmet) is mended an hour
armour_per_hour.source: bb_all/2014_Tools and Supplies.txt: 'Items are repaired at 3 points of durability per hour (tick) rate.'

camp_repair_mult.unit: times the repair rate while camped
camp_repair_mult.source: bb_all/2014_Tools and Supplies.txt: 'When Camped or Escorting Caravan (contract) repair rate is doubled for the same time interval.'

durability_per_tape.unit: points of durability one TAPE mends
durability_per_tape.source: bb_all/2014_Tools and Supplies.txt: 'One point of Tools and Supplies is required to repair 15 points of item durability.' (records/target/bb/price_table.json dailyRates.toolDurabilityRepairedPerTool agrees)

blacksmith_repair_mult.unit: times the repair rate with THE BLACKSMITH in the retinue
blacksmith_repair_mult.source: bb_all/1947_The Blacksmith (Follower).txt: 'Increases repair speed by 20%' (the Tools page says 33 percent; the follower's own page wins)

blacksmith_tape_mult.unit: times the tape a point of mending costs with THE BLACKSMITH

surgeon_injury_days.unit: days fewer a man is laid up with THE SURGEON in the retinue
surgeon_injury_days.source: bb_all/1974_The Surgeon (Follower).txt: 'Makes every Injury take one less day to heal'

struck_down_hp_left.unit: hitpoints a man struck down and still alive (or YOU, downed) wakes with
struck_down_hp_left.source: ours: the fight-gets-deep law (struck down: 20 percent dead, else laid up 30 to 40 days); a man who lived has something left

unknown_hp_max.unit: hitpoints the HEAL bar counts for a man who has never stood in a fight and carries no card (he is whole; only his weight in the bar)
unknown_hp_max.source: bb_all/0160_Attributes.txt: a recruit's hitpoints sit around 50 to 60 before his background
